title: A spill or release happens on site
summary: Stop and contain it, make the reports the law requires on time, and bring in environmental counsel and consultants.

situation.trigger: A tenant, contractor or neighbor reports a chemical spill or release at the property.

outlineSteps: Make sure people are safe and call emergency services if needed
Stop the source and contain the release
Find out what was released, how much and whose operation caused it
Have counsel confirm which reports must be made and when
Make the required reports to the agencies
Notify the insurer and the lender
Document the release and every step of the response
Read the tenant's lease for use, compliance and indemnity terms
Oversee the cleanup and the consultant's assessment
Estimate the effect on value and the loan
Tell investors and record the reports, results and costs
